# A transaction whose note is a number followed by a quoted phrase.
#
# `notes: 3 "late fees"` has the shape of a split: a name, then an amount, then
# a commodity in quotes. Only the colon after `notes` says it is a key.
#
# What this fixture produces: one transaction whose notes read `3 "late fees"`.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_key_whose_value_reads_like_an_amount_is_a_key.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-02-01 * "Late fees"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	notes: 3 "late fees"
	Expenses 3.00 CAD
	Assets -3.00 CAD
